before_entry.title_zh: 认知发展与取得的组合解释
before_entry.title_en: Cognitive development and acquired compositional interpretation
before_entry.claim_zh: 实际探测记录形成基本效果及组合次序的解释；在公开递归法则内适用于任意有限表达，并能在剩余支持下执行未训练组合。认知、学习及演化心理的完整解释保持为独立继续目标。 后续形成并修复实际组合连接；构造范围扩大可能使旧证据不足，额外不对称接触重新支持范围内的所有有限表达。
before_entry.claim_en: Actual probe records form an interpretation of primitive effects and composition order; it covers every finite expression under the explicit recursive law and supports untrained combinations with remaining support. The full cognition, learning and evolutionary-psychology objective remains active. The continuation forms and repairs an operative route; expanded construction can defeat old evidence, while an asymmetric encounter restores all-expression transfer within the stated family.
before_entry.scope_zh: 25项新 Lean 定理／52项审计，34项继承审计。语法、记录忠实性、法则范围和安排明示；缺失／失实记录、法则改变与不足保留。反审为作者自审；完整语义、发育演化对应及意识未完成。 构造修复新增37项定理／65项审计，86项继承审计分列；递归、连接器、参照及安排仍明示，发现差错而无部件可失败。
before_entry.scope_en: 25 new Lean theorems / 52 audits, with 34 inherited audits. Grammar, record fidelity, law scope and schedule are supplied; missing/corrupt records, law change and underfunding remain. Author counterreview; full semantics, developmental/evolutionary correspondence and consciousness incomplete. Formation/repair adds 37 theorems / 65 audits with 86 inherited audits; recursion, connectors, reference access and schedule remain supplied, and repair can fail without parts.
